title: NCQ: Code reuse support for Node.js developers
checked_utc_meaning: byte recheck after direct reading; first reading occurred earlier in this session
version: author-hosted version as retrieved; SHA256 in source-retrievals.json
observed: Two sequential baseline-first within-person cohorts; different tasks per condition, five-task balanced assignment. First comparison suppresses search in the same REPL; second changes editor, search, ranking, correction and execution support. Task success is executable JavaScript satisfying the specification. Timestamped inputs and recordings were collected; installation marks package selection. Final analyzed cohorts each contain ten people. Snippet visibility, attempted reuse and successful reuse are distinguished.
limitations: No downloadable participant timing/assignment/scoring table is linked beyond the tool repository. Twenty minutes is a planning estimate, not a verified enforced cap. Training/video precede tasks; activity intervals and later rework are absent. A 1–7 confidence response is not objective quality. Figure distributions cannot supply exact raw timings; matching P labels between cohorts is invalid.

title: Enriching Documents with Examples: A Corpus Mining Approach
checked_utc_meaning: byte recheck after direct reading; first reading occurred earlier in this session
version: author-hosted version as retrieved; SHA256 in source-retrievals.json
observed: 24 students randomized within four Java-skill strata to JavaDocs or mined-example enriched documents, twelve per arm; all lacked java.sql experience. Four sequential SQL subtasks. Task transitions were inferred from next relevant document viewed for over30 seconds; Task3/4 share documents. Time summaries use completers only. A tuple-output test separately classifies pass/fail; no person IDs connect Tables X and XII. Whole-session deadline40minutes is explicit in§5.3.2.
limitations: No individual event, allocation or score file found in paper. Final-submit event, timer origin, training duration and failure reasons are unspecified. Extra examples/popularity and selection change together; same-link explanation effect is unidentified. Table XII Task3 has fewer passes with eXoaDocs; no equivalence margin/CI.

title: Software Engineering User Study Recruitment on Prolific: An Experience Report
checked_utc_meaning: byte recheck after direct reading; first reading occurred earlier in this session
version: author-hosted version as retrieved; SHA256 in source-retrievals.json
observed: The authors explain NCQ recruitment, seven programming checks and invited video sessions. Among14 booked sessions, ten succeeded and four withdrew during sessions; reasons included confidence and observation anxiety. Surveys were separately published.
limitations: NCQ §10.1.2 explicitly points to this report for recruitment, but no withdrawal IDs/condition stages link it to task outcomes. The generic publisher DOI printed in the author preprint is a template; use arXiv2201.05348v2/title. Not a new independent effectiveness experiment.
